messages:
Chen Li: Quick tactical sync — can folks drop status for the token-cost attribution work? need a short list for the infra weekly. blocked items only please.
Maria Ortiz: 2 mins — schema PR almost ready, ran into one nullable edge for `user_id` we should decide. I can push updates today.
Samir Patel: Ownership check: billing-team owns the join downstream (AFAIK) but we need a contract change. @Rachel Kim is that right?
Rachel Kim: yep billing-team owns join. we need the add'l field `token_bucket` added to event schema BEFORE we roll. ETA for our PR: end of day Thursday.
Alex Nguyen: CR ping — I dropped comments on the telemetry ingestion PR (https://git/repo/pull/542). small nits + one request to add a smoke test. please address so I can approve. :eyes:
Chen Li: thanks. Maria — can you paste the minimal schema diff you plan to land? want to confirm no downstream breakage.
Maria Ortiz: sure — diff below. intended to be additive only.
```json
- event.v1 {
-   user_id: string (required)
-   action: string
- }
+ event.v1 {
+   user_id: string (nullable) 
+   action: string
+   token_bucket: string (optional)  // new field for costing join
+}
```
Samir Patel: nullable user_id is fine for logs; billing will do best-effort join. need a fallback mapping when null — filing a ticket: https://tasks/RED-1234
Rachel Kim: noted. billing will add fallback lookup by `session_id`. we'll link PR to the ticket.
Alex Nguyen: infra dependency: eng-runtime will need a tiny change to forward `token_bucket` in the event envelope. @infra-bot any planned deploys that would conflict with our rollout window?
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance: GPU cluster node reboot on Thu 22:00 - 23:00 UTC. No API deploys allowed between 21:30–23:30 UTC.
Chen Li: ok aim to land schema + ingestion PRs Wed evening to give billing a day to test before Thu night window.
Maria Ortiz: I'll tag both PRs with `canary: true` and add smoke tests. pinging @Alex Nguyen for quick review Monday morning.
Alex Nguyen: I can review Monday morning — will prioritize.
Samir Patel: dependency note: analytics team wants the token-cost mapping table populated by Friday 18:00. billing team, can you confirm that fits your timeline?
Rachel Kim: Friday EOD is tight but should be doable if schema lands Wed. we may have one follow-up migration but non-blocking.
Chen Li: plan summary: 1) Maria lands schema PR Wed evening, 2) ingestion PR + smoke tests land Wed, 3) billing links to ticket and runs join tests Thu daytime, 4) final check before Fri EOD cost table populate. owners: schema/ingest = Maria, join/mapping = Rachel, smoke tests = Alex, overall coord = Chen.
Maria Ortiz: noted. I'll post PR links here once open. :thumbsup:
Alex Nguyen: leaving a reminder to include token-usage histogram in the canary dashboards — otherwise we won't catch regressions.
Samir Patel: I'll add a short alert if histogram drops >20% within canary period.
Rachel Kim: thanks — will run tests against canary and report results in this thread.
Chen Li: perfect. if any blocker appears, call it out here or in #eng-oncall. otherwise I'll prep the weekly slide with this timeline.
Maria Ortiz: PRs created: https://git/repo/pull/548 (schema) and https://git/repo/pull/549 (ingest). left a note about nullable user_id.
Alex Nguyen: reviewing now. small style comment on 549, otherwise LGTM.
Rachel Kim: starting join smoke tests now, will update in ~1h.
Samir Patel: added alert rule in staging.
Chen Li: last check — bump me if anything slips. thanks everyone. :rocket:
